Infinix has launched its GT 50 Pro in the Indian market, branding the handset as a liquid‑cooled device built for high‑performance gaming. The announcement was covered by Moneycontrol and listed on GSMArena’s upcoming launches.

The phone’s cooling architecture is promoted as part of a “smartphone‑to‑console” gaming ecosystem, allowing users to connect the device to larger displays for console‑like experiences. No pricing or detailed specifications were disclosed in the initial release.
